responsibility: Implements the public C/C++ intrinsic header for the RISC-V cache-management operation extensions. It exposes always-inline user-facing wrappers for Zicbom cache-block clean/flush/invalidate operations, Zicboz cache-block zero, and Zicbop prefetch operations, gating each set of declarations on the corresponding predefined extension macro and forwarding calls to the matching GCC builtins, so source code can request these target-specific cache and prefetch instructions through a stable header interface rather than calling backend builtins directly.
